On the other hand, working at home can be lonely and some people find it difficult to separate work and private life. In my opinion, the best solution is to work at home some days and in the office on other days.
insights.suggested_text: The trend of working from home has several advantages. One of them is that individuals save time and money as they no longer have to commute to the office. Another benefit is the flexibility to organize their day as they see fit. However, working from home can also have its drawbacks. For instance, it can be isolating and difficult to separate work and personal life. Therefore, a possible solution is to work from home some days and in the office on other days.

insights.title: Use of the passive voice
insights.description: The essay uses the passive voice in some sentences, which can make the writing seem less engaging. For example: 'Remote working has become increasingly common' could be rephrased as 'Many people now work from home, a trend that has become increasingly common.'
insights.original_text: Remote working has become increasingly common
insights.suggested_text: Many people now work from home, a trend that has become increasingly common.
